name: capability port
wording: each capability has one implementation, the cratylus runtime, which delivery places on every host it installs to; agents reach it through a thin harness tool that calls that implementation and adds no behaviour of its own, and the operator through the cratylus command, so both always reach the same version and supporting another harness never reimplements a capability.
reason: The runtime the adapters call, and the operator's command, must be on the host; the port was silent on how it gets there.
